text: defective have to send back. While the frame looks nice, the part that is normally glass is clear plastic.  There is a film that has writing on this plastic that you need to peel off.  Unfortunately, the writing is also on the clear plastic "glass" part.  It is obviously a defect but I still have to go to the trouble of taking it to the UPS store to return.  I shouldn't have to do that since this is a quality control problem with the company.  Not happy and won't buy from again.
